claims.reasoning: Seattle's got a bye, that's not a strategy, that's a hole in the lineup. Buffalo's got teeth and three bucks is the going rate for a defense, I don't overthink it.

Thirty-two points outta nowhere last week, kid touched the ball and did something with it — I don't care what the sheet says he's supposed to do this week, I've built a life on that gap. Fannin's been sitting on my bench doing nothing but collecting dust, that ain't family, that's furniture.

forum_post: Quiet week, that's fine, I don't need the noise to know what I got. Lawrence threw for 350 and twenty-seven cost me six bucks, somebody wanna talk about value, we'll talk. Everybody else can keep whispering, I'm busy eating.
